procedure: Open ballot. Each eligible Safe signer signs the published ballot text with the signer wallet on Etherscan Verified Signatures; signatures are verified with ecrecover (EIP-191) and recorded here.
eligibility: Safe signers of the Treasury, Community and LP Reserve Safes (identical 3-of-5 owner set), snapshot when the ballot opens.
deadline: None, unless a deadline is approved by a separate Council vote.

ballots.title: CommitmentVault V1 compensation (urgent)
ballots.question: Compensate the 11 permanently locked CommitmentVault V1 tranches (26,418,467.994338353 IFR) from the LP Reserve Safe, per tranche, only after each tranche’s original time condition and price target (7-day TWAP) are met.
ballots.rule: Approved with 3 YES votes of eligible Safe signers.

options.YES:
IFR Council urgent vote CV-01
Vote: YES
I approve proposal CV-01: the 11 permanently locked CommitmentVault V1 tranches (26,418,467.994338353 IFR in total) are compensated from the LP Reserve Safe 0x5D93E7919a71d725054e31017eCA86B026F86C04. Each tranche is compensated with exactly its locked amount, paid to the wallet that locked it, only after that tranche's original time condition (if any) and its original price target (7-day TWAP of the IFR/WETH Uniswap V2 pair 0xbE495E9c0d8cc2DCf95570cf95B63c4844dF31A0) are met, with one Safe transaction per tranche.
Proposal: https://ifrunit.tech/wiki/commitment-vault-compensation.html (repository commit f08ce370)
options.NO:
IFR Council urgent vote CV-01
Vote: NO
I reject proposal CV-01: the 11 permanently locked CommitmentVault V1 tranches (26,418,467.994338353 IFR in total) are compensated from the LP Reserve Safe 0x5D93E7919a71d725054e31017eCA86B026F86C04. Each tranche is compensated with exactly its locked amount, paid to the wallet that locked it, only after that tranche's original time condition (if any) and its original price target (7-day TWAP of the IFR/WETH Uniswap V2 pair 0xbE495E9c0d8cc2DCf95570cf95B63c4844dF31A0) are met, with one Safe transaction per tranche.
Proposal: https://ifrunit.tech/wiki/commitment-vault-compensation.html (repository commit f08ce370)

ballots.note: The proposal text references repository commit f08ce370 (pre-history-rewrite SHA; the same content is commit 4c3eb668 after the 2026-10-03 history rewrite).

ballots.title: No IFR incentives for exchanges
ballots.question: Centralized exchanges receive no IFR incentives (no integration payments, no liquidity grants, no loans) from any project pool.
ballots.rule: Approved with 3 YES votes of eligible Safe signers.

options.YES:
IFR Council vote EX-01
Vote: YES
I approve proposal EX-01: centralized exchanges receive no IFR incentives (no integration payments, no liquidity grants, no loans) from any project pool. Listings must be self-sustaining. A future incentive requires a new Council proposal.
Context: transfer-fee exemption for verified exchange addresses remains as approved on 2026-08-26; each exemption follows the published address verification procedure and its own Safe proposal with the 48-hour timelock.
options.NO:
IFR Council vote EX-01
Vote: NO
I reject proposal EX-01: centralized exchanges receive no IFR incentives (no integration payments, no liquidity grants, no loans) from any project pool. Listings must be self-sustaining. A future incentive requires a new Council proposal.
Context: transfer-fee exemption for verified exchange addresses remains as approved on 2026-08-26; each exemption follows the published address verification procedure and its own Safe proposal with the 48-hour timelock.

ballots.note: Approved on 2026-10-04 with 3 YES (G.M., M.G., Y.K.). Policy decision; no on-chain action. A future exchange incentive requires a new Council proposal.

ballots.title: Governance role of exchanges
ballots.question: Option A: no governance role for exchanges. Option B: at most two disclosed non-voting advisers without Safe permissions.
ballots.rule: The option with 3 votes of eligible Safe signers is adopted.

options.OPTION A:
IFR Council vote EX-02
Vote: OPTION A
On proposal EX-02 (governance role of centralized exchanges) I vote for Option A: exchanges receive no governance role, no Council membership, no adviser seat and no Safe permissions.
Option B would have allowed at most two disclosed non-voting advisers without Safe permissions.
options.OPTION B:
IFR Council vote EX-02
Vote: OPTION B
On proposal EX-02 (governance role of centralized exchanges) I vote for Option B: at most two disclosed non-voting exchange advisers, without Council voting rights and without any Safe permissions.
Option A would give exchanges no governance role at all.

ballots.note: Open. Three eligible signers abstained; with two signers outstanding no option can reach 3 votes unless votes change. Until a decision, the status quo applies: exchanges have no governance role. The owner is checking whether the outstanding signers want to vote.
